title: Regional GPU runway scenario planner - mid 2026
content:
Purpose and scope:
This working sheet lays out three capacity scenarios (conservative / baseline / aggressive) for NA, EU, APAC across Jan 2026 - Dec 2026. Intent: give product & platform leads a 12-month runway view, explicit rollout windows for new GPU families, and a short de-risking checklist tied to triggers and owners.

Assumptions (baseline):
- Baseline growth = +18% monthly token throughput demand for hosted API and +12% for Dedicated aggregated over all customers (weighted).
- Average sustained utilization target = 68% for provisioned pools; safe headroom target = 22% (warm spares + burst).
- Preferred GPU families per region: NA: H100 (primary), A100-80GB (fallback); EU: A100-80GB (primary), H100 (fallback); APAC: A10G/A100 mix initially, ramp to H100 in Q3.
- Normal provisioning lead time: 6-9 weeks for cloud reservations; 10-14 weeks for on-prem procurement.
- Quantization / perf improvements expected to yield 12% effective capacity boost by Q3 if rollout of Optimize recommendations completes.

Summary table (capacity lanes in GPU-equivalent units, where 1 unit = 1 H100-equivalent slot):

Month | Region | Conservative | Baseline | Aggressive
Jan-26 | NA   | 420 | 560 | 700
Jan-26 | EU   | 220 | 300 | 380
Jan-26 | APAC | 150 | 210 | 280
Apr-26 | NA   | 480 | 640 | 820
Apr-26 | EU   | 260 | 350 | 450
Apr-26 | APAC | 170 | 260 | 340
Jul-26 | NA   | 520 | 710 | 920
Jul-26 | EU   | 300 | 420 | 540
Jul-26 | APAC | 200 | 320 | 430
Oct-26 | NA   | 560 | 780 | 1040
Oct-26 | EU   | 340 | 480 | 620
Oct-26 | APAC | 240 | 380 | 520

Interpretation notes:
- Baseline uses conservative procurement cadence but assumes Optimize deliverables complete by end of Q2 (12% boost baked in).
- Aggressive assumes faster procurement (cloud spot commitments + Dedicated customer commits) and higher conversion from pilot customers.
- Conservative assumes a 6% soft-landing improvement via software only; no hardware upgrades beyond scheduled replacements.

Rollout windows (high level):
- H100 primary rollout (NA): pilot pool deployable by 2026-03-15, regional scaled rollout Apr-Jun (GA by 2026-07-01) contingent on kernel stability and SLO tests.
- EU fallback strategy: maintain A100 capacity through Q2, begin controlled H100 capacity switch in Q3 with dual-routing for 8 weeks.
- APAC staged availability: expand A100 + A10G pools through Q2, schedule H100 cutover in August-September to align with cloud region availability and sales commitments.

Utilization stress tests (what to simulate):
- Spike scenario: +60% demand over baseline for 48 hours (simulate cold/KB cache miss). Verify prefix cache hit ratios and burst routing to Dedicated.
- Sustained runway squeeze: linear growth at baseline + 25% for 6 weeks (test autoscale thresholds and eviction policies).
- Degraded network region: upstream latency increase of 30ms for requests routed to remote regions (validate fallback routing latencies and user-visible error rates).

Trigger matrix and actions:
- Trigger: baseline utilization > 75% for 3 consecutive days in any region -> Action: open temporary burst capacity (cloud burst), enable aggressive KV cache retention, notify sales ops; Owner: Maya Rodriguez.
- Trigger: rolling 7-day tail latency increase > 20% vs baseline -> Action: rollback recent kernel changes, throttle batch sizes, lock new model rollouts; Owner: Liam O'Connor.
- Trigger: committed Dedicated contracts arriving sooner than planned (>=2 customers) -> Action: prioritize reserved pools in affected region, accelerate H100 procurement; Owner: Priya Shah.

De-risking checklist (short):
- Validate cross-region fallback routing policies and automatic model variant selection (SRE).
- Maintain a 10-15% warm spare pool per region for the next two quarters (Capacity ops).
- Run bi-weekly capacity smoke tests with synthetic traffic (Platform engineering) and log results to Confluence.
- Finalize Optimize quantization rollout by 2026-06-15 and measure effective capacity delta (Applied ML).
- Confirm procurement SLAs with cloud vendors (legal + procurement) including replace/repair windows.

Owner commitments & next steps:
- Ethan Li: consolidate procurement P0 list and submit cloud reservation requests by 2026-02-20.
- Maya Rodriguez: run first spike stress test in NA on 2026-02-28 and post results.
- Liam O'Connor: prepare rollback runbook for new kernel in case of latency regressions (due 2026-03-05).
- Priya Shah: align Sales with APAC H100 availability window and collect committed buys (due 2026-04-01).

Open questions / To follow up:
- Do we prioritize H100 across all NA pools or keep a mixed fleet per customer tier? (decision needed by 2026-03-01).
- Is there appetite for aggressive spot+reserved blend in EU to shorten lead times? (Finance input).
- Confirm fraction of Dedicated commit growth that will be provisioned on H100 vs A100 in Q3.

Appendix (quick math examples):
- Runway months = (Current spare slots) / (expected incremental monthly demand in H100-equivalent). Example NA baseline: spare = 120 slots, incremental monthly demand = 80 -> runway = 1.5 months.
- Effective capacity after Optimize = raw_slots * 1.12 (if quantization + perf features fully applied).

Document history and sign-off:
This is a working sheet intended to be shared with product-hosted-api, product-dedicated, applied-ml, and SRE. Move to final once procurement confirmations and the Q1 stress test are complete.
